name: Natchitoches Parish, LA
findings: Natchitoches Parish has 138 nonprofit organizations. 52 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 42 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (37% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Natchitoches Parish has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Natchitoches Parish list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 42 organizations here; 31% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
